option_relations.rationale: Bradycardia-dependent (phase 4) His-Purkinje block is a specific type of atrioventricular block, making it a subtype of the broader Atrioventricular Block.
Third-degree atrioventricular block is a severe form of atrioventricular block, thus a subtype of Atrioventricular Block.
Mobitz type II second-degree atrioventricular block is a specific classification of atrioventricular block, making it a subtype of Atrioventricular Block.
Paroxysmal Atrioventricular Block is a type of atrioventricular block characterized by intermittent occurrence, thus a subtype of Atrioventricular Block.
